input: Schedule a termite bond renewal with the exterminator

gold.taskTitle: Schedule Termite Bond Renewal With Exterminator
gold.taskDescription: Contact the exterminator to schedule a termite bond renewal appointment for the user's property.

questions.title: Which exterminator company holds your current bond?
questions.description: Identify the specific pest control company the user already has a relationship with.

questions.title: When does your current termite bond expire?
questions.description: Determine the expiration or renewal date of the existing termite bond.

questions.title: Do you have the exterminator's contact information handy?
questions.description: Find out if the user has the phone number, email, or account number needed to reach the company.

questions.title: Is this a renewal inspection or just a contract renewal?
questions.description: Clarify whether a physical inspection visit is required or if the renewal is handled administratively.

questions.title: What days or times work best for the appointment?
questions.description: Understand the user's scheduling availability to find a suitable appointment window.

questions.title: Is this for a home, rental property, or commercial space?
questions.description: Identify the type of property to ensure the correct bond type and service level is arranged.

questions.title: Do you want to compare other companies before renewing?
questions.description: Determine if the user wants to explore alternative providers or simply renew with the current one.
